_comment: Published reference compounds for hypothesis testing in the Digital Twin tab. Values are lifted verbatim from _CALIBRATION_DATA in app.py, which in turn comes from Table 3 of the source paper. Add new entries here -- no code change needed. IMPORTANT: every compound in this seed set is part of the model's own calibration set, so agreement between prediction and measurement is NOT independent validation. 'logbb_models' lists published logBB equations that can be run alongside the app's own Tier-2 predictor for hypothesis testing.

bae2024.citation: Yang, Shin, Jeong, Bae et al., Pharmaceutics 2024, 16(5), 574
bae2024.assay: Human BBB-on-a-chip; Kp = brain-side:vascular-side partition coefficient

clark1999.title: Rapid calculation of polar molecular surface area and its application to the prediction of transport phenomena. 2. Prediction of blood-brain barrier penetration
clark1999.assay: QSAR regression on 55 diverse organic compounds; reported R^2 = 0.787

rishton2006.assay: Linear logBB model in the same two-descriptor family as Clark 1999

logbb_models.name: This app — Tier 2 stacked ML
logbb_models.note: Stacked RF/XGB -> Ridge regressor trained in this pipeline (CV R^2 = 0.604). The default.

logbb_models.name: Clark 1999
logbb_models.note: Two-descriptor QSAR. Published using Clark's own rapid PSA and clogP; here it is evaluated with RDKit TPSA and Wildman-Crippen logP, which is the usual substitution but is NOT identical to the descriptors Clark fitted on.

logbb_models.name: Rishton 2006
logbb_models.note: Same descriptor family as Clark 1999, with a notably weaker PSA penalty. Same descriptor-substitution caveat applies.
